meta.source_data_tree_note: git tree id of data/ when generated; equals `git rev-parse <commit>:data` for any commit with the same data
assumptions: FMJ direct hit at point blank: no falloff, ricochet or penetration
blast_factor is [Radius.Inner, Radius.Outer] for a radial hit (Damage §1.1); Inner within EffectiveExplosiveRadius; Outer is beyond that radius. Both radius tags are evaluated.
hostile instigator with no instigator tags; rules that need instigator or target tags are skipped
section health stops at 0; routing as in Vehicle §4.2

projectile hits take the section of their triangle's slot as in Vehicle §3.1; radial applications use the section resolved from the vehicle's first component hit, while each hit's own hit-location tag still drives its rule factor; unreachable names why no registered component can produce a slot key
hits_to_destroy counts hits through that slot until the main health reaches 0; null when it never does (no damage, or no route to the main health)

Only the gun mount is shown. The gun's own proxy (CC_Browning_Gun) attaches to a receiver_J bone that SK_Browning_Mounted doesn't have; with partial attachments not enabled (0x50EF920) it is likely never attached.

Damage state: every wheel deflated (state 1) or destroyed (state 2), Vehicle §3.2's wheel mesh swap. Destroyed shows the destruction mesh; deflated keeps the intact look and traces the destruction mesh's hull (AlternativeCollisionHull, 0x5389A46). The slot name comes from the hit component's own collision mesh and the index from the hull triangle, which is always 0 (0x50BF880), so a deflated hit gives CC_Wheel, slot 0 of the intact mesh: both states give this hitbox. A wheel deflates at TyreHealth / max ≤ 0.55 and is destroyed at TyreHealth ≤ 0 (0x537C580).

The turret housing's collision mesh (CC_WHL_08_TurretHousing) is authored in vehicle space, but the data attaches it at the turret socket like a socket-local mesh, so its hitbox sits about 2 m above the roof. Shown where the data places it; whether the game corrects this is not traced.
